open_points.subject: create_viewer
open_points.text: - create_viewer: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST assign a fresh uuid4 viewer_id to the new ClientViewer, together with ACTIVE status, the supplied display_name, the current created_at, the authorized administrator as created_by, and None revoked_at and revoked_by. viewer_id is a required identity: omitting it, deriving it from the display_name, or reusing an existing viewer's identity are all forbidden.
open_points.other_text: - ClientViewer fields (exact, no others exist): created_at: datetime, created_by: UUID, display_name: str, revoked_at: datetime | None, revoked_by: UUID | None, status: ViewerStatus, viewer_id: UUID
open_points.question: Must created_by receive the StaffActorContext described as “the authorized administrator,” or must the note change to require the administrator's staff_id UUID?

open_points.subject: grant_viewer_project
open_points.text: - grant_viewer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST assign a fresh uuid4 grant_id to the new ProjectViewerGrant, with ACTIVE status, the validated project_id, the current created_at, the authorized administrator as created_by, and None revoked_at and revoked_by; grant_id is a required identity and MUST NOT be omitted.
open_points.other_text: - ProjectViewerGrant fields (exact, no others exist): created_at: datetime, created_by: UUID, grant_id: UUID, project_id: UUID, revoked_at: datetime | None, revoked_by: UUID | None, status: GrantStatus, viewer_id: UUID
open_points.question: Must created_by receive the StaffActorContext described as “the authorized administrator,” or must the note change to require the administrator's staff_id UUID?

open_points.subject: describe_viewer_session
open_points.text: - describe_viewer_session: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST read the selected session through tx.viewer_access().get_viewer_session(actor.session_id), require that it still exists, belongs to actor.viewer_id, is unrevoked and unexpired at the one captured current time, and return ViewerSessionView(session_id, viewer_id, expires_at) only; any authentication outcome raises AuthenticationRejected and no token/hash is returned.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def get_viewer_session(self, session_id: UUID) -> ViewerSession | None
open_points.question: Must get_viewer_session be called on PortalTransaction as declared, or must its contract be declared on ViewerAccessRepository so tx.viewer_access().get_viewer_session is valid?

open_points.subject: revoke_viewer_access
open_points.text: - revoke_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST treat every persisted record as immutable: assigning to a field of a value read from a repository raises, because instances are frozen. It MUST build a replacement instance carrying the changed fields and hand that to the repository, leaving the value it read untouched. The addressed credential and every session of that viewer become replacements carrying revoked_at and revoked_by, so revoking a credential also ends the sessions it authorised.
open_points.other_text: - ViewerSession fields (exact, no others exist): created_at: datetime, expires_at: datetime, revoked_at: datetime | None, session_id: UUID, token_hash: str, viewer_id: UUID
open_points.question: Must ViewerSession gain a revoked_by field, or must the note stop requiring session replacements to carry revoked_by?

open_points.subject: sign_out_viewer
open_points.text: - sign_out_viewer: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST close its one explicit transaction exactly once, rolling back on failure only while it is still open, and use only tx.viewer_access().get_viewer_session and update_viewer_sessions; failures before commit rollback once and re-raise unchanged.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def get_viewer_session(self, session_id: UUID) -> ViewerSession | None
# PortalTransaction
def update_viewer_sessions(self, sessions: list[ViewerSession]) -> None
open_points.question: Must these operations be called directly on PortalTransaction as declared, or must their contracts be declared on ViewerAccessRepository to support the required tx.viewer_access() route?
